domain.description: Concept domain, e.g. "module_patterns". Promoted from payload.domain (UPG-30); payload still carries it.

concept.description: Concept name. Promoted from payload.concept (UPG-30); payload still carries it.

confidence.description: Extractor confidence for this node. Promoted from payload.confidence (UPG-30).

source_language.description: Language the node was extracted from. Promoted from payload.source_language (UPG-30).

extraction_method.description: How the concept was detected. Promoted from payload.extraction_method (UPG-30). Distinguishes deterministic AST extraction from regex pattern matching.

paradigm.description: Programming paradigm of the source language. Reserved by UPG-30; not populated yet.

purity.description: Whether the node's logic is side-effect free. Reserved by UPG-30; real side-effect analysis lands in Phase 4 (UPG-41). Absent means not analysed — do not infer PURE from absence.

complexity.description: Cyclomatic or structural complexity. Reserved by UPG-30; not populated yet.

source_license.description: SPDX identifier of the source file's license, where known. Reserved by UPG-30; not populated yet.

tags.description: Free-form classification tags. Reserved by UPG-30; not populated yet.
